strings.text: The first independent school in the country to host a Children’s Defense Fund Freedom School — and still the only one running it every summer.

strings.text: Service here is measured and externally recognized: thousands of logged hours, national volunteer awards, and a global network membership no other school in the state holds.

strings.text: A summer literacy program for K–8 Charlotte scholars run with Freedom School Partners. strings.text: The grade-level partnerships and the Charger Impact Challenge are curricular initiatives rather than clubs, and the President’s Volunteer Service Award is an individual recognition of logged hours, not a membership. strings.text: There is no standing honor-societies page. Every fact here comes from one-off news posts, so the published counts are historical rather than current — 89 NHS inductees in 2017, 34 Cum Laude members in 2022, nearly 50 art inductees one May, 11 Tri-M inductees in 2019. Induction criteria are published only for the National Honor Society; the other four publish none.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn paj pèmanan sou sosyete onè yo. Chak enfòmasyon isit la soti nan piblikasyon nouvèl izole, kidonk kantite ki pibliye yo se istorik olye ke aktyèl — 89 nouvo manm NHS an 2017, 34 manm Cum Laude an 2022, prèske 50 nouvo manm nan atizay yon mwa me, 11 nouvo manm Tri-M an 2019. Kritè admisyon pibliye sèlman pou National Honor Society la; kat lòt yo pa pibliye okenn.

strings.text: No Middle School honor society could be confirmed, and despite five world languages on offer only the French society is evidenced. strings.t: Komite DEI pa divizyon pou pwofesè ak anplwaye · Sesyon Aprantisaj Edikasyon DEI pou Paran · Parent Cookbook Club la, ki “transfòme modèl klib liv tipik la an yon eksperyans kiltirèl imèsif… k ap eksplore kilti divès yon bèl resèt alafwa.” Okenn nan sa yo se pa yon gwoup afinite ki baze sou idantite.

strings.text: The DEI page describes "the student-led Diversity Club and Alliance Groups" in a single sentence and links to a "Diversity Club List" — but that link leads to a page containing no list. No affinity group count is published anywhere, so unlike its peers there are no rival numbers to reconcile; there is simply no roster. No Lower or Middle School groups are published, and no student diversity leadership corps or national conference attendance appears anywhere on the site.
strings.t: Paj DEI a dekri “Diversity Club la ak Alliance Groups elèv yo dirije” nan yon sèl fraz epi li mete yon lyen sou yon “Diversity Club List” — men lyen sa a mennen nan yon paj ki pa gen okenn lis. Pa gen okenn kantite gwoup afinite ki pibliye okenn kote, kidonk kontrèman ak lekòl parèy li yo pa gen chif rival pou rekonsilye; senpleman pa gen lis. Pa gen okenn gwoup Lower oswa Middle School ki pibliye, e pa gen okenn kò lidèchip divèsite elèv ni patisipasyon nan konferans nasyonal ki parèt okenn kote sou sit la.

strings.text: Service is deliberately not required — and students still logged 3,396 hours by the end of junior year, with a recognition society and a national first behind them.
strings.t: Sèvis la se espre yo pa egzije l — epi elèv yo te toujou anrejistre 3,396 èdtan anvan fen twazyèm ane a, ak yon sosyete rekonesans ak yon premye nasyonal dèyè yo.

strings.text: The school states plainly that it has no service-hours graduation requirement; what it has instead is a reflection-based recognition model running across all four Upper School years.
strings.t: Lekòl la di klèman li pa gen okenn kondisyon èdtan sèvis pou gradyasyon; sa li genyen olye a se yon modèl rekonesans ki baze sou refleksyon k ap kouri atravè tout kat ane Upper School yo.

strings.text: hours to be inducted · since 1997-98
strings.t: èdtan pou antre · depi 1997-98

strings.text: A recognition society, not a requirement: it "recognizes students who make significant contributions to the community through service" using a reflection-based model across all four Upper School years. Four-year students need 150 hours, prorated for transfers, and are inducted at the end of senior year.
strings.t: Yon sosyete rekonesans, se pa yon kondisyon: li “rekonèt elèv ki fè kontribisyon enpòtan nan kominote a atravè sèvis” lè l sèvi ak yon modèl ki baze sou refleksyon atravè tout kat ane Upper School yo. Elèv kat ane bezwen 150 èdtan, pworata pou elèv transfè, epi yo antre nan fen dènye ane a.

strings.text: Habitat houses funded & built

strings.text: Charlotte Latin is "the first private or independent school in the country with a senior class that funded and built a Habitat for Humanity House." The community has since funded and built four, and regularly assists with builds locally and in El Salvador.
strings.t: Charlotte Latin se “premye lekòl prive oswa endepandan nan peyi a ki gen yon klas dènye ane ki te finanse epi bati yon Kay Habitat for Humanity.” Depi lè sa a kominote a finanse epi bati kat, epi li ede regilyèman nan konstriksyon lokalman ak nan Salvadò.

strings.text: Three school-wide partners — Baby Bundles, Special Olympics and Habitat for Humanity of the Charlotte Region — anchor a program governed by six Principles of Good Practice. The Upper School Service Council organizes service activities available every week of the year.
strings.t: Twa patnè pou tout lekòl la — Baby Bundles, Special Olympics ak Habitat for Humanity of the Charlotte Region — ankre yon pwogram ki gouvène pa sis Prensip Bon Pratik. Upper School Service Council la òganize aktivite sèvis ki disponib chak semèn nan ane a.

strings.text: On the numbers
strings.t: Sou chif yo

strings.text: An earlier profile recorded 5,485 hours for the Class of 2018 by the end of junior year, with five class members qualifying for the Service Society and seven students earning a Presidential Volunteer Service Award in 2016-17. A fourth initiative, Good Neighbors, lends campus gym space to community organizations.
strings.t: Yon pwofil pi bonè te anrejistre 5,485 èdtan pou Klas 2018 la anvan fen twazyèm ane a, ak senk manm klas la ki te kalifye pou Service Society la epi sèt elèv ki te genyen yon Presidential Volunteer Service Award an 2016-17. Yon katriyèm inisyativ, Good Neighbors, prete espas jimnazyòm kanpis la bay òganizasyon kominotè.

strings.text: The school lists Blessings in a Backpack — which meets every Wednesday to pack weekend food for students on free lunch — and Student Council separately from its club roster, as standing activities rather than open-enrollment clubs. Service Council–organized weekly activities are likewise individual service activity, not club membership.
strings.t: Lekòl la liste Blessings in a Backpack — ki reyini chak mèkredi pou anbale manje wikenn pou elèv ki gen manje midi gratis — ak Student Council apa de lis klib li a, kòm aktivite pèmanan olye ke klib ak enskripsyon lib. Aktivite chak semèn Service Council la òganize se menm jan an aktivite sèvis endividyèl, se pa manbraj nan klib.

strings.text: Two recognition societies plus a theatre society — and, uniquely in this comparison, published induction criteria and a published induction count.
strings.t: De sosyete rekonesans plis yon sosyete teyat — epi, inikman nan konparezon sa a, kritè admisyon pibliye ak yon kantite admisyon pibliye.

strings.text: A nine-member prefect system of faculty-mentored student leaders — Head, Academic, Admissions, Athletic, Global Awareness, Fine Arts, Service, Spiritual Life and Student Life. The Global Awareness Prefect is the identity and global leadership role; the Service Prefect is the civic one.
strings.t: Yon sistèm prefè nèf manm ak lidè elèv pwofesè ap mentore — Head, Academic, Admissions, Athletic, Global Awareness, Fine Arts, Service, Spiritual Life ak Student Life. Global Awareness Prefect la se wòl lidèchip idantite ak mondyal la; Service Prefect la se sa ki sivik la.

strings.text: The school runs two overlapping global/cultural student groups and never reconciles them. The Diversity & Belonging page names only Global Knights; the Knights Headlines feature names only Knights Nations Club; and the Upper School clubs list names neither, omitting both from its 13-club roster. The count of global/cultural groups therefore reads as none, one or two depending which page you open, and no page publishes a total.
strings.t: Lekòl la fè de gwoup elèv mondyal/kiltirèl ki sipèpoze epi li pa janm rekonsilye yo. Paj Diversity & Belonging la nonmen sèlman Global Knights; atik Knights Headlines la nonmen sèlman Knights Nations Club; epi lis klib Upper School la pa nonmen ni youn ni lòt, li kite tou de deyò nan lis 13 klib li a. Kantite gwoup mondyal/kiltirèl la kidonk li kòm zewo, youn oswa de depann de ki paj ou louvri, epi okenn paj pa pibliye yon total.

strings.text: No affinity groups by race, ethnicity, gender, religion or orientation exist anywhere on the site, and no Middle or Lower School cultural groups — those divisions get programming only. No membership counts, meeting schedules or faculty sponsors are published for any of the three groups, and Global Knights has no page of its own.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn gwoup afinite pa ras, etnisite, sèks, relijyon oswa oryantasyon okenn kote sou sit la, e pa gen okenn gwoup kiltirèl Middle oswa Lower School — divizyon sa yo jwenn pwogramasyon sèlman. Pa gen okenn kantite manm, orè reyinyon oswa parenn pwofesè ki pibliye pou okenn nan twa gwoup yo, epi Global Knights pa gen pwòp paj pa l.

strings.text: Service is a graduation requirement here — every Upper Schooler earns 1.0 Winterim credit across four years, a quarter-credit at a time.
strings.t: Sèvis se yon kondisyon pou gradyasyon isit la — chak elèv Upper School genyen 1.0 kredi Winterim sou kat ane, yon ka kredi alafwa.

strings.text: Knights Serve, anchored in Micah 6:8, is the umbrella; Winterim is the structural commitment that makes service unavoidable rather than optional.

strings.text: Winterim trips are a graduation requirement and a travel program, Kingdom Impact Day is a division-wide service day, and the Multicultural Festival is an annual all-school event. strings.t: Vwayaj Winterim yo se yon kondisyon pou gradyasyon ak yon pwogram vwayaj, Kingdom Impact Day se yon jounen sèvis pou tout divizyon an, epi Multicultural Festival la se yon evènman anyèl pou tout lekòl la. Sèvis Cross-Cultural Communications la se yon klas k ap fè sèvis; Vocational Shadowing ak Alternative Winterim Experience yo ranje endividyèlman epi fanmi yo negosye yo. Okenn nan yo se pa yon klib.

strings.text: The Winterim packet states that the program "does not count toward additional requirements for conservatory or service hours" — proving a separate service-hours expectation exists. Yet no numeric hours target is published anywhere on the site, along with no participation percentage, no total hours, and no founding year for Knights Serve. The Knights Serve page advertises 2025-26 service projects with no detail behind the heading.
strings.t: Pakè Winterim la deklare pwogram nan “pa konte pou kondisyon adisyonèl pou konsèvatwa oswa èdtan sèvis” — sa ki pwouve yon atant èdtan sèvis apa egziste. Poutan pa gen okenn objektif nimerik èdtan ki pibliye okenn kote sou sit la, ansanm ak pa gen pousantaj patisipasyon, pa gen total èdtan, e pa gen ane fondasyon pou Knights Serve. strings.text: The Student Diversity Leadership Corps (SDLC) gives selected Middle and Upper Schoolers a formal role in the school's diversity work. Since 1998 the school has sent two faculty from each division and six Upper School students to the NAIS People of Color Conference every year.
strings.t: Student Diversity Leadership Corps (SDLC) la bay elèv Middle ak Upper School ki chwazi yon wòl fòmèl nan travay divèsite lekòl la. strings.text: "We have a rich club life, ranging from the significant such as our Affinity Groups, to fun and adventurous clubs like the Star Wars Club, and service-based clubs such as the Habitat Club." Clubs are student-led and faculty-supported, meeting during and after school. That sentence is the entire published record.
strings.t: “Nou gen yon lavi klib rich, ki soti nan bagay enpòtan tankou Affinity Groups nou yo, rive nan klib amizan ak avantiwye tankou Star Wars Club la, ak klib ki baze sou sèvis tankou Habitat Club la.” Klib yo dirije pa elèv ak sipò pwofesè, epi yo reyini pandan ak apre lekòl. Fraz sa a se tout dosye ki pibliye a.

strings.t: Middle ak Lower School

strings.text: No affinity groups appear in either division. Middle School Student Life lists academic competition teams only — Battle of the Books, Elementary Battle of the Books, Science Olympiad, Model UN, Envirothon — plus Student Council.

strings.text: No parent affinity groups. "Parents at Cannon" is a general volunteer network organized as Connect, Create, Cultivate and Champion, with no identity-based subgroups.
strings.t: Pa gen gwoup afinite paran. “Parents at Cannon” se yon rezo volontè jeneral òganize kòm Connect, Create, Cultivate ak Champion, san okenn sougwoup ki baze sou idantite.

strings.text: No affinity group is named anywhere on cannonschool.org — no roster, no descriptors, no count, and so no count discrepancy either. There is no standalone DEI page: "Diversity, Belongingness, and Engagement" is an anchor section on the About page carrying commitment statements and twelve Individual and Community Agreements, but no groups, programs or names. No student diversity leadership arm and no national conference attendance are published.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn gwoup afinite ki nonmen okenn kote sou cannonschool.org — pa gen lis, pa gen deskripsyon, pa gen kantite, kidonk pa gen okenn kontradiksyon kantite non plis. Pa gen yon paj DEI apa: “Diversity, Belongingness, and Engagement” se yon seksyon ankraj sou paj About la ki pote deklarasyon angajman ak douz Individual and Community Agreements, men pa gen gwoup, pwogram oswa non. Pa gen okenn branch lidèchip divèsite elèv ni patisipasyon nan konferans nasyonal ki pibliye.

strings.text: Service is explicitly not a graduation requirement — and Upper Schoolers still log almost 10,000 hours a year.
strings.t: Sèvis eksplisitman se pa yon kondisyon pou gradyasyon — epi elèv Upper School yo toujou anrejistre prèske 10,000 èdtan chak ane.

strings.text: The school frames this as evidence of commitment rather than compliance, and backs it with a universal senior capstone and a week-long experiential program.
strings.t: Lekòl la chapante sa kòm prèv angajman olye ke konfòmite, epi li sipòte l ak yon kapston dènye ane inivèsèl ak yon pwogram eksperyansyèl yon semèn.

strings.t: Yon pwojè sèvis ki pèmèt chak elèv dènye ane plonje nan yon kòz filantwopik yo renmen, ki fini ak yon prezantasyon bay pwofesè, anplwaye, kanmarad ak manm kominote a ak tan pou refleksyon ak kesyon. Liste pami Signature Learning Experiences lekòl la.

strings.text: A week-long experiential program after winter break that "challenges students to think critically and practically, to serve others," across local-community, professional-skills and trips-and-certifications tracks. Service offerings include a Sea Island Habitat for Humanity trip and a food-bank week studying food insecurity.
strings.t: Yon pwogram eksperyansyèl yon semèn apre vakans divè a ki “defi elèv yo pou yo panse yon fason kritik ak pratik, pou yo sèvi lòt moun,” atravè pis kominote lokal, konpetans pwofesyonèl ak vwayaj-ak-sètifikasyon. Ofrann sèvis yo enkli yon vwayaj Sea Island Habitat for Humanity ak yon semèn nan yon bank manje k ap etidye ensekirite alimantè.

strings.t: Nan Middle School la

strings.text: A grade-level service-learning model has students investigate topics, identify needs in teams and build action plans, with guest speakers from more than eight organizations including Special Olympics, the Society of St. Andrew Gleaning Network and the Cabarrus County Soil & Water Conservation District. Off-campus work runs to the Share the Harvest community garden, Salvation Army food drives and the Cabarrus County Bilingual Preschool.
strings.t: Yon modèl aprantisaj-sèvis pa nivo fè elèv yo envestige sijè, idantifye bezwen an ekip epi bati plan aksyon, ak envite ki pale ki soti nan plis pase uit òganizasyon ki enkli Special Olympics, Society of St. Andrew Gleaning Network ak Cabarrus County Soil & Water Conservation District. Travay deyò kanpis la rive nan jaden kominotè Share the Harvest, kanpay manje Salvation Army ak Cabarrus County Bilingual Preschool.

strings.text: The Senior Capstone is an individual graduation-track project and Winterm is a curricular program — neither is a club. Because service is not required, the ~10,000 hours explicitly include individual efforts rather than club membership. The Habitat Club is the exception: it is the one named service club.
strings.t: Senior Capstone la se yon pwojè endividyèl sou pis gradyasyon epi Winterm se yon pwogram kourikoulè — ni youn ni lòt se pa yon klib. Paske sèvis pa obligatwa, ~10,000 èdtan yo enkli eksplisitman efò endividyèl olye ke manbraj nan klib. Habitat Club la se eksepsyon an: se sèl klib sèvis ki nonmen an.

strings.text: The hours figure is unstable across the school’s own publications. An earlier 2024-25 profile said around 15,000; the current Upper School page says almost 10,000; the 2025-26 profile drops the statistic altogether. We show the current published figure and scope it to the Upper School, since that is the page carrying it.
strings.t: Chif èdtan an pa estab atravè pwòp piblikasyon lekòl la. Yon pwofil 2024-25 pi bonè te di anviwon 15,000; paj Upper School aktyèl la di prèske 10,000; pwofil 2025-26 la retire estatistik la nèt. Travay afinite a chita anba angajman Diversity, Belongingness & Engagement (DBE) la.

strings.text: A service ladder that scales with age — fourth graders at twenty community sites, middle schoolers twice a year, and high schoolers building housing for Pine Ridge.
strings.t: Yon echèl sèvis ki grandi ak laj — elèv katriyèm ane nan ven sit kominotè, elèv Middle School de fwa pa ane, epi elèv lekòl segondè k ap bati kay pou Pine Ridge.

strings.text: Program-based rather than hours-logged: no service-hour requirement exists, and the school publishes no annual totals.

strings.text: Davidson Day is the first high school ever to collaborate with the program. Thirteen Upper Schoolers completed two deliberation modules on social safety nets and constitutional rights, attending expert panels and two-hour small-group deliberations built around civil discourse rather than debate-to-win.

strings.text: Two of the school’s most striking service stories are explicitly not clubs. Longevity LKN is a student-founded 501(c)(3) nonprofit — not a school club — that has screened over 100 community members for blood pressure across Lake Norman. The AFAR archaeology work, in which 13 students excavated the Adam Spach Rock House alongside professional archaeologists as the first high schoolers to work with the North Carolina State Historic Preservation Office, is never defined as a club on the school’s own page. The Deliberative Citizenship partnership is a structured program, and Patriot Pals is a peer-mentorship tradition.
strings.t: De nan istwa sèvis lekòl la ki pi frapan yo eksplisitman se pa klib. Longevity LKN se yon òganizasyon san bi likratif 501(c)(3) elèv yo fonde — se pa yon klib lekòl — ki fè tès tansyon pou plis pase 100 manm kominote a atravè Lake Norman. Travay akeyoloji AFAR la, kote 13 elèv te fouye Adam Spach Rock House la ansanm ak akeyològ pwofesyonèl kòm premye elèv lekòl segondè ki travay ak North Carolina State Historic Preservation Office, pa janm defini kòm yon klib sou pwòp paj lekòl la. Patenarya Deliberative Citizenship la se yon pwogram estriktire, epi Patriot Pals se yon tradisyon mentora ant kanmarad.

strings.text: The 100-hour practicum belongs to an opt-in diploma track, not a school-wide graduation requirement — and no school-wide service-hours requirement is published anywhere. No hour totals, partner counts or founding years accompany the Middle School program. Five of the six Community and Culture cards, including the Community Engagement Council, have no detail page behind them.

Pa gen total èdtan, kantite patnè oswa ane fondasyon ki akonpaye pwogram Middle School la. strings.text: Service is a graduation requirement, not a club — 25 hours every year for every Upper School student, and a 40-hour Capstone every senior must complete.

strings.text: Peer mentoring runs the length of a school year and pairs each junior and senior with a fourth grader.

strings.text: minimum, required of every senior

strings.text: Every senior completes an approved internship, research or community-service project of no less than 40 hours, focused either on preparation for a professional career or on advancing one of the school’s core values. It begins in the second semester of junior year and completes in the first semester of senior year, with documentation and reporting throughout — and carries 0.25 credit.
strings.t: Chak elèv dènye ane konplete yon estaj, yon rechèch oswa yon pwojè sèvis kominotè yo apwouve ki pa mwens pase 40 èdtan, ki konsantre swa sou preparasyon pou yon karyè pwofesyonèl swa sou avanse youn nan valè debaz lekòl la. Li kòmanse nan dezyèm semès onzyèm ane a epi li fini nan premye semès douzyèm ane a, ak dokimantasyon ak rapò pandan tout tan an — epi li pote 0.25 kredi.

strings.text: Selected juniors and seniors spend several days each fall in the mountains with the fourth-grade class, leading activities on the relationship between the environment and the human race. The relationships formed become a mentoring programme: each eleventh- and twelfth-grade student continues to meet and work with their fourth-grade mentee throughout the school year.
strings.t: Elèv onzyèm ak douzyèm ane yo chwazi pase plizyè jou chak otòn nan mòn yo ak klas katriyèm ane a, k ap mennen aktivite sou relasyon ant anviwònman an ak ras imèn nan. Relasyon ki fòme yo vin tounen yon pwogram mentoraj: chak elèv onzyèm ak douzyèm ane kontinye rankontre epi travay ak elèv katriyèm ane l ap mentore a pandan tout ane eskolè a.

strings.text: All Upper School students must complete a minimum of 25 hours of volunteer service each year, rising to 40 hours for National Honor Society members. Juniors additionally plan, organise and execute their own community-service project.
strings.t: Tout elèv Upper School dwe konplete yon minimòm de 25 èdtan sèvis volontè chak ane, ki monte a 40 èdtan pou manm National Honor Society. Anplis, elèv onzyèm ane yo planifye, òganize epi egzekite pwòp pwojè sèvis kominotè pa yo.

strings.text: The recognition ladder above the requirement
strings.t: Nechèl rekonesans ki anwo egzijans lan

strings.text: Beyond the 25-hour floor, the President’s Service Award recognises Upper School students who have served 100 or more hours, and the Middle School runs its own Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award at 50+ hours a year. So there is a documented ladder at three levels — 25 required, 50 recognised in the Middle School, 100 recognised in the Upper School — plus the 40-hour NHS threshold sitting alongside.
strings.t: Pi lwen pase planche 25 èdtan an, President’s Service Award la rekonèt elèv Upper School ki sèvi 100 èdtan oswa plis, epi Middle School la fè pwòp Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award pa l a 50+ èdtan pa ane. Kidonk gen yon nechèl dokimante nan twa nivo — 25 egzije, 50 rekonèt nan Middle School la, 100 rekonèt nan Upper School la — plis sèy 40 èdtan NHS la ki chita akote.

strings.text: iGEM Synthetic Biology
strings.t: iGEM Synthetic Biology

strings.text: Gold medal; four teams — 2012, 2016, 2018 and 2020
strings.t: Meday lò; kat ekip — 2012, 2016, 2018 ak 2020

strings.text: The flagship. iGEM (International Genetically Engineered Machine) is a university-level synthetic-biology competition with a separate high-school track, and Gaston Day has fielded four teams from a 510-student school. Documented projects include a kudzu phytotoxin and an E. coli K-12 isobutanol biofuel; the Duke undergraduate iGEM team has supported the squad. The gold medal is third-party-confirmed — the archived iGEM team wikis return 403 to automated fetches, so the medal level was not re-verified at source in this pass, though team participation across all four years is confirmed by those archived pages.
strings.t: Pi gwo a. iGEM (International Genetically Engineered Machine) se yon konpetisyon byoloji sentetik nan nivo inivèsite ki gen yon pis apa pou lekòl segondè, epi Gaston Day mete kat ekip sou teren apati yon lekòl 510 elèv. Pwojè dokimante yo enkli yon fitotoksin kudzu ak yon byokabiran izobitanòl E. coli K-12; ekip iGEM etidyan Duke yo sipòte gwoup la. Meday lò a konfime pa yon twazyèm pati — wiki ekip iGEM ki achive yo bay 403 bay fetch otomatik, kidonk nou pa t re-verifye nivo meday la nan sous la nan pas sa a, byenke paj achive sa yo konfime patisipasyon ekip la nan tout kat ane yo.

strings.text: Gaston Day publishes no clubs or activities page. PrivateSchoolReview enumerates 14 activities and Niche adds several more; the school itself names only 3-D Printing Club, Green Team and International Council, by way of example, and states that students "can start a new club by securing a faculty sponsor." The roster is therefore an open-ended snapshot rather than a census, and its size is not a figure any source states.
strings.t: Gaston Day pa pibliye okenn paj klib oswa aktivite. PrivateSchoolReview enimere 14 aktivite epi Niche ajoute plizyè lòt; lekòl la menm nonmen sèlman 3-D Printing Club, Green Team ak International Council, kòm egzanp, epi li deklare ke elèv yo “can start a new club by securing a faculty sponsor.” Kidonk lis la se yon foto ouvè olye ke yon resansman, epi gwosè l pa yon chif okenn sous deklare.

strings.text: iGEM and VEX Robotics are documented in the school's own Academic Profile and, for iGEM, by four archived competition team wikis (2012, 2016, 2018, 2020). These are university-level competitions with high-school tracks, and fielding them from a 510-student school is the most distinctive thing on this roster.
strings.t: iGEM ak VEX Robotics dokimante nan pwòp Academic Profile lekòl la epi, pou iGEM, nan kat wiki ekip konpetisyon ki achive (2012, 2016, 2018, 2020). Sa yo se konpetisyon nan nivo inivèsite ki gen pis pou lekòl segondè, epi mete yo sou teren apati yon lekòl 510 elèv se bagay ki pi distenktif sou lis sa a.

strings.text: Middle School students elect required LEAD courses alongside art, drama, chorus and band, and run their own Student Government. The Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award recognises 50+ volunteer hours a year. No separate Middle School club roster is published.
strings.t: Elèv Middle School yo chwazi kou LEAD obligatwa yo ansanm ak atizay, dram, koral ak fanfa, epi yo fè pwòp Student Government pa yo. Spartan Strong Volunteer Service Award la rekonèt 50+ èdtan volontè pa ane. Pa gen okenn lis klib Middle School apa ki pibliye.
